name: How are plumbing and electrical changes handled during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How are plumbing and electrical changes handled during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you work with a hands-on general contractor, you have a single point of contact who oversees the entire job from demolition to finish carpentry. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra manages the job directly on-site with his crew handling carpentry, drywall, tile, and painting. Plumbing and electrical work are handled by coordinated specialty sub-trades, ensuring all technical systems meet residential standards while finish details like molding and tile align seamlessly with the broader plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your general contractor coordinates licensed plumbing and electrical trades during rough-ins while the in-house crew handles framing, drywall, tile, and finish work.
